description: List Prices for a Product. The "List Prices for a Product" API allows retrieving a paginated list of prices associated with a specific product. Customize your results by filtering prices or paginate through the list using the provided query parameters.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_listPricesForProduct
